name: fal-sdk
description: Official fal.ai Python monorepo. Three packages: `fal` (serverless Python runtime — deploy ML apps with a CLI), `fal-client` (lightweight Python client for calling fal.ai model endpoints), and `isolate-proto` (gRPC protobuf definitions for the isolate service). Supports sync/async, streaming, realtime WebSocket, file upload, queuing, and secrets management.
author: fal-ai (Features & Labels)

fal.description: Serverless Python SDK + CLI for deploying apps to fal.ai

fal_client.description: Lightweight Python client for calling fal.ai model endpoints

isolate_proto.description: gRPC protobuf definitions for the fal isolate service

install.auth: export FAL_KEY=your_key  # or: fal auth login

fal_sdk: CLI: run, deploy, auth, keys, secrets, files, queue, runners
toolkit: Image, Audio, Video, File, KV store

security_review.notes: Official fal.ai Python SDK. subprocess.run used only for 'python -m build' and 'nvidia-smi' with fixed lists (no shell=True). pickle.loads reads only local IPC error files, not remote data. No eval() of remote content, no shell injection. Published on PyPI.
